glosses: bewitched, enchanted, spellbound (of a person; experiencing being enchanted or bewitched)
bewitched, enchanted, spellbound (of a look, one's eyes, etc.; expressing being enchanted or bewitched)
past passive perfective participle of заворожи́ть (zavorožítʹ)
Under the influence of a magical spell; enchanted, bewitched, or supernaturally constrained.

examples.text: At once he sniffed the smell of man. At once he feared his hidden lair had been looted while he slept. How had a man dared to come so close? He must have trod next to the dragon's head so as not to be spellbound.

glosses: Fascinated by something; entranced as if by a spell; captivated.

examples.text: The story left the children spellbound.

glosses: simple past and past participle of enchant

examples.text: The children listened, enchanted by the storyteller’s voice.
They wandered through the enchanted forest.

glosses: A greeting used when introduced to someone for the first time, especially by a man when introduced to a woman.

examples.text:
There sate a Spirit in the vault,
In shape, in hue, in lineaments, like life,
And by him couch’d, as if intranced,
The hundred-headed Worm that never dies.

glosses: Held at attention, as if by magic.

examples.text: The entranced spectator was cut off from reality as long as the adventure lasted; it was as if he lived a dream yet believed he was awake.

glosses: simple past and past participle of entrance
Personne à qui un fascinateur a jeté le mauvais œil.

examples.text: Avec de multiples arguments, le moine formé pour partie à Padoue élabore une théorie psycho-physiologique de la fascination dont les vecteurs principaux sont les « esprits » à la fois spirituels et corporels qui sont mus par l’âme du fascinateur jusqu’au corps du fasciné, entre théorie de l’âme, physique, optique et médecine.

glosses: Participe passé masculin singulier de fasciner.

examples.text: Fasciné par la merveillosité de Madeleine Havouable, il bavouille et bafouille.

glosses: Entièrement possédé, dominé, subjugué par une personne que l’on aime.

examples.text: J'avançais lentement dans mon lecture, mais j'étais comme envoûté .

glosses: Participe passé masculin singulier du verbe envoûter.
